top_signals.title: Energy Companies Set to Lead European Earnings Growth Again

top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices moved higher earlier today, after Iranian officials told Reuters the country’s forces were planning to further intensify strikes on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, deploying new tactics. Brent crude was trading at $106.37 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $94.72 per barrel, with the news that Israel’s Benjamin Netanyahu had asked Trump to start bombing Iran again likely to also contribute to the price rise.
